items.question: Do I have to close my WhatsApp group?
items.answer: No. Keep it for chat and photos and pin the booking link. Bookings and payments move to {{brand.name}}.

items.question: What can I import?
items.answer: Guest lists from a CSV or Excel file, and past applications from a form export such as Google Forms. Match your columns, check the preview and import.

items.question: Will my guests have to download an app?
items.answer: No. They book on your page in their phone’s browser.

items.question: I still have events on sale elsewhere.
items.answer: Leave them there and put your next event on {{brand.name}}. You can import those guest lists afterwards.

items.question: Can I take my contacts out again?
items.answer: Yes. Export your contacts from {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} whenever you like.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Nothing for 30 days from your first event on {{brand.name}}, or 90 for founding hosts. Then 5% of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 a month. Help moving your list is free.
